en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a panoramic view from a wooded hillside looking down onto a small town in a valley, with church spires and scattered buildings surrounded by fields and low hills. Tall tree trunks frame the foreground. The caption in red at the bottom reads "Blick auf Flöha." and in smaller red print along the lower margin it reads "6280 Brück & Sohn, Meissen 1905". The lower part of the card is left blank for writing.
